title: Quasar Core
blurb: Dive through rotating debris, gravity wells and armoured reactors to the heart of a quasar.

levels.name: Outer Debris
levels.intro: Welcome to the core. Break twenty pegs in the turning debris belts.

levels.name: Signal Array
levels.intro: Three antenna rows slide past. Break every orange signal peg.

levels.name: Crystal Satellites
levels.intro: Catch the six gem satellites as they orbit the core.

levels.name: Fragmented Shield
levels.intro: Break the fragile shield bricks. Glass lets your ball pass through.

levels.name: Accretion Belt
levels.intro: The dark centre pulls the ball. Work around it and break the orange pegs.

levels.name: Plasma Cascades
levels.intro: The streams shift sideways. Make one chain of ten hits.

levels.name: Binary Beacons
levels.intro: Two small reactors rotate in opposite directions. Light all eight lanterns.

levels.name: Ion Lattice
levels.intro: A shifting lattice fills the chamber. Break thirty pegs.

levels.name: Locked Orbit
levels.intro: Collect the blue key to open the inner gates and reach the gems.

levels.name: Gravitational Lens
levels.intro: Aim around the gravity well. Hit every orange peg in the two lenses.

levels.name: Radiant Score
levels.intro: Build fever and score eighteen thousand points among the radiant rings.

levels.name: Armour Vault
levels.intro: Blast powers and lightning crack armour. Break the vault and its outer bricks.

levels.name: Wormhole Relay
levels.intro: The paired portals cross the chamber. Find all eight gems in the shifting lanes.

levels.name: Pulsar Clock
levels.intro: The pulsar hands circle the lanterns. Light all six without touching the spikes.

levels.name: Shear Field
levels.intro: The debris streams shear in opposite directions. Break thirty four pegs.

levels.name: Echo Chamber
levels.intro: Keep the ball bouncing through the hexagons. Make a chain of twelve.

levels.name: Event Horizon
levels.intro: A fast ring of orange pegs skirts the black hole. Clear all twelve targets.

levels.name: Containment Failure
levels.intro: Break the turning containment bricks. The centre is no longer safe.

levels.name: Last Light
levels.intro: Save the eight lanterns circling the fading star. Watch the outer spike patrol.

levels.name: Heart of the Quasar
levels.intro: One final reactor. Open the shield and clear the orange core to finish the journey.
